comments.text:
I don't think people realize the sheer insanity of 500 IQ. At this point, you're beyond alien. For statistical comparison. 50% of people are below or equal to 100 IQ. 15% are between 100 and 115. 2% are above 130 and 0.1% are above 145 and that is only 3 standard deviations from the mean. 

When you go from 195 IQ (1 in 8 billion) to 200 IQ (1 in 70 billion), that's rarer than the way from 100 to 195.

Now, what about 300 IQ? Well, you go from a peak intelligent individual to an alien superintelligent general intelligence who could learn anything instantly. The chances are of 1 in 10 to the power of 40... Or more than the amount of atoms on Earth. Standing at 13 standard deviations from the meal. 

Alright, now that we understand how ridiculous 300 is, let's look at 500.

First off, 26 standard deviation, second off, 1 in 10 to the power of 155, or 1 with 155 zeroes behind it. To put that into perspective, the UNIVERSE has 10 to the power of 80 atoms in it. 

At this point, your relationship with a human is larger than the relationship a human and an amoeba have, in other words, to you, normal humans are what microbes are to normal humans. They're indistinguishable from each other. 

The gap between 500 and 200 is wider than the gap in communication between a microbe and a human, the gap between a normal person and someone with 500 IQ would make communication utterly meaningless. Someone with 500 I could learn all human knowledge in about a day and compute any domain from it, they could compile physical properties and combine them in all sorts of incredibly strange ideas and bizarre reasonings that would work but make no sense to any normal person.
